question: How many orders have been placed in the shop in total?
What is the shop's total revenue in PLN?
What was the revenue in August 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) = '2026-08'

question: Which product category brought in the most revenue?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product sold the most units?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value?
How many customers have placed at least 12 orders?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 12)

question: In which month was revenue the highest? Give the month as YYYY-MM.
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of tea were sold in total?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Tea'

question: Which product currently has the fewest units in stock?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 1
